title: fix(runtime): the environment-membership check reads the organization a session's resolution vetted
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1zG3Xn4JonaKvDLLr5gnjL)_

Refs #28284

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：多环境宿主上，环境成员检查对平台组织(platform organization)的放行，对会话(cookie)登录的调用者，现在读取本次请求身份解析后核定的组织，也就是其他各处已在读取的同一个值。
- **为什么改**：QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)
- **风险与回滚**：只改 `@objectstack/runtime`(patch)。
  - API key 和 OAuth 访问令牌登录的调用者不变。
  - 没有环境作用域的宿主、关闭该检查的宿主(`api.enforceProjectMembership: false`)不变。
  - 回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts` 的 `enforceProjectMembership`，会话分支新增的 `else`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/http-dispatcher-membership-vetted-organization.test.ts`，预期 3/3。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位做 contract review 后落地。

## What changes

- **`HttpDispatcher.enforceProjectMembership`:** for a caller a session cookie admitted, the organization the platform-organization pass reads is `executionContext.tenantId`, the one `resolveRequestScope` resolved, when that resolution is of the same user. It is the value `resolveActiveOrganizationId` already answers to every other door.
  - With no resolution of that user on the request, no organization is read, and the caller is judged.
  - The API-key and OAuth arms (#31396) are unchanged.

## Why

QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)

## Verification

Readings on head `bcdc77c82` (two commits on `main` at `4cd48e277`; the second only rewords comments, test names and the changeset).

<details><summary>Pins, red-first and restore</summary>

- New `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher-membership-vetted-organization.test.ts` (3). It runs the real identity step on each request under an `isolated` posture, on a multi-tenant host whose `sys_environment_member` holds no row.
  - A session is judged in the organization its resolution vetted.
  - CONTROL: a member of the platform organization passes, with no membership read.
  - CONTROL: a session in another organization the user is in is judged.
- `http-dispatcher.test.ts`, RBAC block:
  - The platform-org case now carries the resolution `dispatch()` writes before the gate.
  - New case: with no resolution, another user's resolution, or a resolution with no organization, the caller is judged.
  - A module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'` (`check:test-source-alias`).
- Red-first with `main`'s `http-dispatcher.ts`: 2 failed | 253 passed (255). The two new cases failed.
- Restored: 263 passed (263) across the two files and #31396's `http-dispatcher-membership-resolved-principal.test.ts`.

</details>

<details><summary>Package suite, typecheck and gates</summary>

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/runtime`: exit 0. `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three changed files: exit 0.
- Under the verify lock, after a full `pnpm build`, on the first commit: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 561 passed (561), Tests 9007 passed | 19 skipped, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derives 67 families on this diff.
  - 66 exited 0 on the first run. `check:test-source-alias` exited 1 for the missing module-top import above, and exits 0 after it.
  - `check:type-check-debt` ran under the verify lock: exit 0.
  - `--ran` reconciliation: 67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- The second commit changes comments, test names and the changeset text only; the three focused files read 263/263 and eslint exit 0 on it.

</details>

Not measured:
- A live multi-environment host with a real auth plugin. The identity step is the real one; the session and the stores are stand-ins.
